experiment_data.hypothesis: Instruction routing (25/32 heads attending to instruction tokens) is primarily learned through VLA fine-tuning, not inherited from language pretraining. Llama-2-7B base (no VLA training) injected into OpenVLA should show intermediate attention patterns between untrained-VLA (0/32 heads) and trained-VLA (25/32 heads), proving VLA training amplifies routing beyond pretraining baseline.

spec.command: python create_llama2_base_openvla.py + cross_instruction_extract_dense.py --condition llama2base + l1_attention_visualization.py --condition llama2base
spec.model_name: openvla-7b-llama2base (Llama-2-7B base weights injected into OpenVLA)
spec.eval_data: LIBERO cross-instruction 10 tasks × 50 demos (same as cross_inst_extract_trained)
